notes.title: Orcs like to fuck elfes is available now!
notes.content:
[b]Storyline[/b]
For a long time the kingdom of the Elves lived in peace and harmony, they organised orgies and received sexual energy with the help of the Elf Princess, who gave them strength and power. But one day, Orcs decided to take the sexual energy and attacked the kingdom of Elves. Now it's up to you to rescue the princess at any cost and bring her back.

An exciting and savoury plot where the fate of the Elfes kingdom depends on your actions.

[b]Hot 🍓 Content[/b]
- Sexy and high quality renders.
- A chance to see strawberry content with different characters in the game.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Auto battle system
- Catch and sell fish
- Serve at the bar
- Collect armour and upgrade your hero

and more...

Great battles, exciting plot and lots of hot strawberries await you.

[b]Grab your weapons and set out to save the princess from the hands of the Orcs![/b]
